tasks.title: Check backup retention
tasks.body: Review how many daily and weekly snapshots we keep on the NAS.

tasks.title: Verify the nightly backup
tasks.body:
Confirm the backup starts after the disk scrub.

- Check the 04:00 timer
- Restore a sample file
- Record the snapshot ID

Keep the existing retention policy.

tasks.title: Rotate the staging certificate
tasks.body: Renew the staging TLS certificate and confirm the chain before deployment.

tasks.title: Draft the release checklist
tasks.body: List the smoke tests, rollback steps and release notes for the next version.

tasks.title: Audit unused containers
tasks.body: Compare running containers with the service inventory and report anything unused.

tasks.title: Update the runbook
tasks.body: Document the new backup schedule and recovery steps.

tasks.title: Review the alert thresholds
tasks.body: Check the proposed disk and memory thresholds against last week's traffic.
tasks.summary: Thresholds are ready for a final review.

tasks.title: Confirm the restore test
tasks.body: Restore a sample document from the latest snapshot.
tasks.summary: The restored file matches its original checksum.
